name: codemode
description: Read-only workspace JS. Await tools.read({path}|{next})→{lines:[{n,text}]}, tools.search({pattern})→{matches:[{path,line,text}]}, tools.ls({path})→{entries:[{name,kind}]}, tools.glob({pattern})→{paths}. Return the answer; a bare expression is null.

timeoutSeconds.description: Guest deadline; default 10s. Host I/O may finish later.
